items.summary: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today addressed the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. Acknowledging Mr. Michael Bloomberg’s earlier remarks, the Prime Minister celebrated the forum's unprecedented debut in India. He praised the platform's ability to unite the world’s brightest minds to deliberate on key global themes, including the economy, technology, energy, and international…
items.title: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi addresses the Bloomberg New Economy Forum

items.summary: Industrial pollution abatement is emerging as a key pillar river rejuvenation, with regulation increasingly evolving from conventional enforcement to continuous compliances, scientific monitoring, cleaner production, resource efficiency and technological improvement.
items.title: Industrial Pollution Abatement: Sustainability through Regulations under Namami Gange

items.summary: Provisions for Amnesty were introduced as a transitional measure in the Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) Scheme 2026, notified on 29.06.2026. These provisions offer a one-time opportunity for regularisation of exemption status of Provident Fund (PF) Trusts that are recognized under the Income Tax Act, 1961 (43 of 1961), but lack a formal exemption order granted under section 17 of the…
items.title: Retrospective regularization of exempt status of Provident Fund (PF) Trusts through Amnesty Scheme, 2026

items.summary: A charkha spinning in a village once spoke of nationalism. Today, that spirit is taking new shape through a growing ecosystem of rural enterprises. Honey, herbal products, banana fibre, textiles and other village industries are creating new possibilities for traditional skills.
items.title: Khadi & Village Industries: From Tradition to Enterprise

items.summary: The Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) released the Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) monthly report for September, 2026, which provides a detailed analysis of types and categories of public grievances and the nature of disposal. This is the 53 rd report on Central Ministries/Departments published by DARPG.
items.title: DARPG releases the 53rd Monthly Report on Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) for Central Ministries/ Departments performance for the month of September, 2026

items.summary: The 21st Maritime State Development Council (MSDC) concluded today in Mumbai with landmark outcomes for India’s maritime sector. This was the first meeting of the MSDC after its recognition as a statutory consultative body under the Indian Ports Act, 2025, notified on 15th May 2026. The Council, originally constituted in 1997, now functions with an enhanced mandate to promote integrated…
items.title: 21st Meeting of Maritime State Development Council Concludes Successfully at Mumbai
